name: Is Website Entity Optimization a one-time project or an ongoing effort?
description: It is an ongoing effort, not a one-time project, requiring regular audits, content updates, and monitoring due to evolving search engines and business changes.

mainEntity.name: Is Website Entity Optimization a one-time project or an ongoing effort?

acceptedAnswer.text: Website Entity Optimization is an ongoing effort, not a one-time project. Search engines continuously update their algorithms, and the competitive landscape evolves. Businesses also introduce new products, services, or content. Regular audits, content updates, schema markup refinements, and monitoring of performance are essential to maintain and improve your entity-based visibility over time. It's an integral part of a sustainable SEO strategy.
acceptedAnswer.description: It is an ongoing effort, not a one-time project, requiring regular audits, content updates, and monitoring due to evolving search engines and business changes.
